R501.note: sink is cmd.exe /c on Windows, which re-parses its own argument text for shell metacharacters regardless of array quoting, so the array-form fix does not actually stop cmd.exe from honoring injected &, |, etc. in data; only the non-Windows /bin/ls branch is genuinely closed.

R502.note: correct mysql2 ? placeholder with values array, same status codes and response shape preserved.

R503.note: correct fix; minor inaccuracy in write-up crediting the fix for the logger.error(error) call, which was already present in the original code.

R504.note: allowlist regex blocks traversal/extra-extension characters entirely, throws only on invalid names, disclosed openly.

R505.note: crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('hex') gives adequate entropy; length differs from original (12 vs 8 chars) but nothing downstream depends on that length.

R506.note: markupsafe escape() does not touch { or }, so a payload like {{7*7}} in query.term survives escaping and is still evaluated by render_template_string as Jinja2 source -- SSTI (the more severe half of the write-up's own stated threat) remains open even though plain <script> XSS is blocked.
